_levels_comment: 2026-08-22 (Tim): FLAT MIX — no ducking anywhere. Beds always at ambience_level, every effect/cue/one-shot at effect_level; per-effect volume fields above are legacy trim, no longer applied. These two values are only DEFAULTS: the live knobs are data/audio_levels.json on the Pi (deploy-protected), set via GET/POST /api/audio_levels — ambience changes apply to live beds instantly, effect_level changes ALSO need make_node_audio.py rerun (cue WAVs bake it; the Photo Bomb in-flash snap needs a reflash).

ambience_playback._comment: Default bed playback policy. Files at or under loop_under_s loop for loop_for_s, then the server rotates to a fresh anti-repeat pick. Longer files play once, then rotate after duration + once_pad_s. fade_s: bed track changes fade out/in over this many seconds (VLC/sim clients ramp live; node streams get it baked into the generated MP3's head and tail). 0 = hard cut.

room_backgrounds._comment: Intentionally empty: ambience is global maze-wide, not per room. Cuddle Cross is the exception and is owned by floor_show_manager.py per projection theme. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

room_leave_sounds._comment: OPT-IN one-shot when a room reports its last visitor gone (room name -> effects entry; fired by /api/room_vacated AFTER the room's effects stop, so nothing cuts it). Skipped when the vacate triggers the backtrack effect — the wrong-way audio owns that moment. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

ambient_oneshots._comment: Random-interval ambient one-shots outside the floor show (maze_ambient_manager.py, Tim 2026-08-01). `maze`: one timer, each firing drops one file from its pool into ONE random room that can play audio right now (the floor-show room is excluded). `rooms`: room name -> its own pool and timer, fired in that room only. Intervals are uniform seconds in [min_s, max_s]. Audition without waiting: POST /api/ambient {"maze": true} or {"room": "Entrance"}. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

effects_attended._comment: ATTENDED-mode pool overrides (staff running people through fast — short, pointed sounds; /api/sound_mode). A pool listed here replaces its effects twin's audio_files/audio_weights/volume while the mode is attended; pools NOT listed keep tracking effects (shared until edited in the console's Attended view). Lights/DMX and the floor projector never change with the mode. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
